title: Spec P24 SocialFi revenue share: factory, curve, 4940/4940/120 split, no_price_talk
description: Deliverable: docs/spec/P24_ARCHITECTURE.md for creator tokens with DeFi primitives: creator token factory (1e9 fixed supply, 50/50 market/vesting), bonding curve (supply^2/16000, $69k graduation), fee-split distributor (4940/4940/120 of the 10% trade fee), revenue accrual (7-day epochs), staking + collateral adapters, and the content-policy guard enforcing no_price_talk. Acceptance: (1) token lifecycle written as state transitions with numeric parameters; (2) split math stated as integers summing exactly to the fee with the 4000 bps creator floor; (3) no_price_talk defined as versioned deny-list requirements. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Define P24 Solidity + Python interfaces (factory, distributor, accrual)
description: Deliverable: Solidity interfaces in onchain/src/p24/interfaces/ (ICreatorTokenFactory, IFeeSplitDistributor, IRevenueAccrual) and Python protocols in src/sincor2/defi/p24/interfaces.py. Acceptance: (1) Solidity interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24; (2) Python protocols type-check and cover issuance, splits, claims, staking, and policy screening; (3) interface docs state the live-blocked constraint and the 4000 bps creator floor. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 economics: 6% APR, 12 bps treasury cut, worked creator payout
description: Deliverable: docs/spec/P24_ECONOMICS.md with target_apr=0.06 (staking primitive), fee_bps=12 (treasury = 12 bps of trade value = 120 bps of the 10% trade fee), creator/platform/treasury split 4940/4940/120, risk_score bound 0.33, max_alloc_pct=0.10, min_capital_usd=50.0. Acceptance: (1) worked creator-payout example: $500k/yr volume -> $50,000 fees -> creator $24,700 / platform $24,700 / treasury $600, matching to the cent; (2) dust-to-treasury rounding rule stated; (3) staking rewards sourced as 10% of the platform leg with 72 h unbonding. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Create P24 repo layout: onchain/src/p24/ + src/sincor2/defi/p24/
description: Deliverable: onchain/src/p24/ (factory, curve, distributor, accrual, staking, collateral adapter, policy guard, interfaces), src/sincor2/defi/p24/ (onboarding, interfaces), tests/pytest/test_p24_*.py stubs, configs/agents/p24-socialfi-revenue.yaml, docs runbook stub. Acceptance: (1) solc 0.8.24 compiles the Solidity tree and the Python package imports cleanly; (2) layout mirrors the spec-phase interfaces; (3) agent YAML validates. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 starter boilerplate: factory/distributor stubs, mock revenue
description: Deliverable: CreatorTokenFactory stub, FeeSplitDistributor stub with fixed 4940/4940/120 splits, mock revenue source, Python onboarding stub with TOA hooks and policy screening. Acceptance: (1) solc compiles all stubs with zero warnings; (2) mock issue->split->claim round-trip works in Python with exact split accounting; (3) every stub state-changing path marked live-blocked. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the creator token factory: 1e9 supply, 50/50 split, 5-yr vesting
description: Deliverable: CreatorTokenFactory.sol with permissioned issuance, fixed 1,000,000,000 supply, 50% to bonding curve / 50% to creator vesting linearly over 1,825 days (unvested non-transferable), creator attribution events, ReentrancyGuard + SafeERC20. Acceptance: (1) tokens issue only through the factory with supply caps enforced and attribution events emitted; (2) vesting math verified: 0% claimable day 0, 50% at day 912, 100% at day 1825; (3) onlyFactory minting proven by direct mint attempts reverting. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the fee-split distributor: exact 4940/4940/120, pull claims
description: Deliverable: FeeSplitDistributor.sol splitting each trade's 1000 bps fee as creator 4940 / platform 4940 / treasury 120 (bps of fee), pull-based claims, per-payout try/catch so one failed payout never blocks others, dust to treasury. Acceptance: (1) splits match the spec's exact basis points across fuzzed trade sizes (1 wei to 1e24); (2) creator+platform+treasury == fee exactly for every trade; (3) a reverting claimant does not block other claimants. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build revenue accrual: 7-day epochs, snapshots, no retroactive claims
description: Deliverable: RevenueAccrual module tracking per-creator-token revenue over 604800 s epochs with balance snapshots at epoch start, so late joiners cannot claim past epochs. Acceptance: (1) accrual math matches the spec across epoch boundaries in tests; (2) a holder joining mid-epoch claims only the post-join portion; (3) claims never exceed accrued amounts (fuzzed). Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the content-policy guard: no_price_talk screening at issuance
description: Deliverable: ContentPolicyGuard enforcing no_price_talk on token name/symbol/description/creator bio at issuance and metadata updates, with versioned phrase-based deny-list; violations block issuance or flag the token, citing rule version + matched phrase. Acceptance: (1) 30+ adversarial price-talk samples (predictions, guaranteed returns, 100x promises) are all rejected; (2) legitimate creator metadata passes, including edge cases like the word 'priceless'; (3) every rejection cites rule version and matched phrase. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build DeFi primitives adapters: staking (6% target) + collateral (50% LTV)
description: Deliverable: CreatorStaking (rewards from 10% of platform fee leg, 6% target APR, 72 h unbonding) and CollateralAdapter (creator tokens as collateral in allowlisted venues, max LTV 0.50, per-token exposure <=0.10). Acceptance: (1) staking and collateral flows work against mocked venues with caps enforced; (2) stake/unstake timing attack around epoch snapshots yields no extra rewards; (3) LTV breach attempts revert. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the creator onboarding agent: registration + policy screening
description: Deliverable: src/sincor2/defi/p24/onboarding.py guiding creator registration, validating metadata through the content-policy guard, emitting TOA feedback; full error handling; never signs. Acceptance: (1) a valid creator onboards end-to-end; (2) policy violations rejected with clear errors citing rule version + phrase; (3) any live-intent path raises LiveBlocked. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement 12 bps treasury fee routing with per-creator accounting
description: Deliverable: fee router computing treasury leg = floor(trade_fee * 120 / 10000) + dust per trade, routed to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac with per-creator accounting. Acceptance: (1) fee math matches the P24_ECONOMICS.md $500k-volume worked example to the wei; (2) per-creator ledger attributes every wei; (3) settlement targets only the canonical treasury. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 unit tests: factory, splits, accrual, guard, fees
description: Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p24_socialfi_revenue_unit.py covering factory issuance/vesting, split math, accrual snapshots, content-policy guard true/false positives, and fee math. Acceptance: (1) all tests pass; (2) Solidity coverage via forge and Python coverage >=85%; (3) split tests pin the 4940/4940/120 conservation across fuzzed inputs. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 integration tests: onboard->issue->accrue->split->claim
description: Deliverable: end-to-end tests: onboard to issue to accrue revenue to split to claim, plus staking-primitive flows and policy-violation rejection. Acceptance: (1) green cycle with exact split accounting to the wei; (2) staking flow accrues the 6% target pro-rata with 72 h unbonding enforced; (3) price-talk metadata rejected mid-flow without breaking the valid path. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 invariant/fuzz tests: 1000+ issue/accrue/claim sequences
description: Deliverable: property tests asserting (a) splits always sum to 100% of the fee, (b) no token issues with price-talk metadata, (c) claims never exceed accrued amounts. Acceptance: (1) invariants hold over >=1000 randomized issue/accrue/claim sequences; (2) violations fail loudly with the offending sequence logged; (3) fixed fuzz seeds for reproducibility. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Run P24 mainnet-fork simulation: factory, distributor, accrual
description: Deliverable: fork run of factory, distributor, and accrual with realistic revenue flows, verifying splits and claims. Acceptance: (1) completed run with exact accounting to the wei; (2) zero unexpected reverts; (3) zero live intents emitted (asserted). Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Assemble P24 audit-prep package: snapshot, threat model, limitations log
description: Deliverable: single reviewable directory with frozen snapshot (commit hash recorded), threat model covering split manipulation, accrual gaming, factory permission bypass, and bonding-curve reflexivity, plus known-limitations log. Acceptance: (1) snapshot builds and all P24 tests pass from the frozen tree; (2) each threat maps to a mitigating control and its test; (3) limitations log documents curve reflexivity on the way down plainly. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Remediate P24 audit findings: zero open medium+ with suite green
description: Deliverable: fixes for all audit findings rated medium or higher, each with a regression test. Acceptance: (1) zero open medium-or-higher findings; (2) full P24 suite plus content-policy guard tests re-run green after each fix; (3) each fix references the finding ID in its commit message. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Gas-optimize P24 factory and distributor: 20% reduction target
description: Deliverable: gas measurements per issuance/split/claim path and optimizations targeting >=20% reduction on hot paths without behavior change. Acceptance: (1) committed before/after gas report with per-path numbers; (2) all P24 tests still pass; (3) no change to split math, curve math, or guard semantics (verified by the invariant suite). Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 technical docs: contracts, agents, split/accrual semantics
description: Deliverable: technical docs with component reference for Solidity contracts and Python agents, split and accrual semantics, and content-policy requirements. Acceptance: (1) docs build with zero warnings; (2) every public function documented with params and numeric constraints; (3) the no_price_talk rule-set versioning documented. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Ship P24 agent YAML config and ops runbook
description: Deliverable: configs/agents/p24-socialfi-revenue.yaml (budgets, memory, TOA hooks, check-in cadence) and docs/ops/P24_RUNBOOK.md (creator onboarding, split monitoring, policy escalations + human appeal path). Acceptance: (1) YAML validates; (2) runbook steps executable in order (dry-run first); (3) appeal path for false-positive policy rejections documented. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Add P24 dashboard monitoring hooks: revenue, split drift, policy events
description: Deliverable: monitoring hooks on the feed schema: per-creator revenue and payout metrics, split-drift P0 alert (legs != fee), policy-violation events. Acceptance: (1) hooks emit valid feed-schema events; (2) simulated split drift fires the P0 alert; (3) simulated policy violations emit events with rule version. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P24 testnet deploy scripts: dry-run default, Sepolia end-to-end
description: Deliverable: deploy scripts for factory, distributor, accrual contracts plus offchain agent deployment, with dry-run defaulting ON. Acceptance: (1) scripts run end-to-end on Base Sepolia; (2) agent check-ins visible in logs; (3) flipping dry-run off requires an explicit flag and prints the compliance checkpoint. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Produce P24 mainnet readiness checklist: signed NO-GO by design
description: Deliverable: mainnet readiness checklist (audit signoff, split-parameter freeze at 4940/4940/120, treasury 0x09E289...9612Ac verification, rollback plan, printed compliance checkpoint) recorded as NO-GO by design until re-audit. Acceptance: (1) every item has owner + evidence link; (2) checklist reviewed and signed with NO-GO recorded and the re-audit precondition stated; (3) no mainnet deploy script ships enabled. Judged per specs/p24-socialfi-revenue.md §Acceptance criteria.
